description: This file is a Java interface defining data access operations for OpenMRS metadata objects, including methods for retrieving lists of metadata with options for filtering by retirement status and pagination, as well as counting such objects.

classes.name: OpenmrsMetadataDAO
classes.description: A generic data access object interface for OpenMRS metadata entities providing methods to retrieve and count metadata objects, with support for filtering retired items and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of metadata objects of the specified type, including or excluding retired items based on the parameter.

methods.name: getAllCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of metadata objects of the specified type, optionally including retired objects.

methods.name: getAll (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of metadata objects, with options to include retired objects.
